scope: Selected US criminal-accountability milestones, 2007–2022, read from sources available by 8 March 2026. Not an exhaustive list of proceedings, civil settlements, institutions or later developments.

events.title: Non-prosecution deal
events.text: Federal prosecutors agree not to prosecute in return for a state-based resolution. Victims are not informed before the deal is signed.

events.title: Florida conviction
events.text: Epstein pleads guilty to two state charges, including procuring a minor for prostitution. Sentenced to 18 months, he serves less than 13 and receives work release.

events.title: Federal charges
events.text: Epstein is arrested on charges of sex trafficking of minors and conspiracy. Prosecutors announce the charges on 8 July.

events.title: Death in custody
events.text: Epstein dies before trial. A judge dismisses the federal indictment on 29 August without a verdict on those charges.

events.title: DOJ review of Acosta
events.text: The DOJ finds poor judgment, but no professional misconduct or evidence that Epstein's wealth or connections drove the decision.

events.title: Maxwell convicted
events.text: A jury convicts Ghislaine Maxwell for helping recruit and groom minors for sexual abuse by Epstein.

events.title: 20-year sentence
events.text: A federal court sentences Maxwell to 20 years in prison.
